in_text_mentions: Over a 30‐month follow‐up period, the patient remained asymptomatic, and the lesion demonstrated radiological stability. However, at 35 months, he developed erythematous plaques and confluent papules, predominantly on the back and lower limbs (Figure 1A,B), some of which gradually progressed to ulcerated lesions (Figure 1C). At that time, plasma glucagon levels were elevated at 222 μg/dL (reference range: < 150 μg/dL). A PET‐CT scan revealed no evidence of metastatic disease.
